title: The Binary Signal That Matched a Nuclear Launch Code
hook: A signal from deep space contained a sequence identical to Earth's nuclear launch codes—and it was aimed directly at us.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines real cosmic mystery with existential nuclear fear—paranoia fuel that taps into Cold War triggers.

title: The Moonquake That Lasted 10 Hours—And Came from Something Inside
hook: Apollo seismometers recorded a quake that rang like a bell—and the epicenter was hollow.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'hollow Moon' theory is a classic rabbit hole—this reframes it with real NASA data.

title: The Star That Ejected a Planet—And It's Heading Our Way
hook: A star in the Hyades cluster flung a Jupiter-sized world into interstellar space—and its trajectory points at Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines rogue planet lore with a specific, scary trajectory—creates a countdown narrative.

title: The Declassified NSA File That Tracked 'Unknown Transmissions' from the Kuiper Belt
hook: A leaked NSA document reveals a listening post dedicated to signals beyond Neptune—and they caught something.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy-meets-classified-document format—perfect for the 'they knew' audience.

title: The Mass Extinction That Left No Fossils—Only a Blank Layer of Rock
hook: Geologists found a 26-million-year gap in the fossil record with no explanation—except a layer of pure, sterile clay.
why_this_can_go_viral: Plays on the fear of a completely erased past—makes viewers wonder what else vanished.

title: The Red Dwarf That Flickers Like a Beacon—And It's Getting Brighter
hook: A nearby red dwarf suddenly began pulsing with 300% more light—and the pattern resembles a countdown.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'countdown' pattern triggers urgency—viewers will share it as a doomsday clock theory.

title: The Dark Matter 'Wind' That Is Changing Earth's Rotation Speed
hook: Earth's rotation fluctuates every 12 years—and physicists say it's dark matter blowing through the planet.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ties dark matter to something tangible and weird—people love 'invisible forces affecting Earth' ideas.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: They All Died in a 'Quantum Apocalypse'
hook: A new theory suggests every advanced civilization reaches a quantum threshold—and then uncreates itself.
why_this_can_go_viral: High-concept existential horror—the 'quantum' angle makes it sound both sci-fi and plausible.

title: The Signal That Was a Scream—Recorded by ALMA Telescope
hook: The ALMA array picked up a 17-second radio burst that sounded exactly like a human scream—from a dead star.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'scream' hook is visceral and shareable—it triggers primal fear and curiosity instantly.

title: The Asteroid That Passed Within 3,000 Miles—and No One Knew Until After
hook: A house-sized asteroid missed Earth by less than the width of the Atlantic—and we detected it 5 hours later.
why_this_can_go_viral: Near-miss narratives always perform—this one has the extra fear of 'we didn't even see it coming.'

title: The Planet Where It Rains Molten Glass—And It's Getting Closer
hook: An exoplanet with atmosphere so hot it rains glass sideways is now drifting toward the inner solar system.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual horror of glass rain combined with 'heading our way'—a perfect short-form hook.

title: The Classified Space Shuttle Mission That Retrieved Something from the Van Allen Belts
hook: Declassified logs show Shuttle mission STS-48 retrieved an object from the radiation belts—and it was warm.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy + real shuttle mission + mysterious object = perfect viral cocktail for the cosmic niche.

title: The Extinction That Wiped Out All Ocean Life—Except the Creatures at the Bottom
hook: A mass extinction 250 million years ago killed everything in the sunlit zone—but deep-sea vents kept ancient species alive.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'survivors at the bottom' angle is eerie and raises questions about what still lurks there.

title: The Dark Matter 'Wall' That Is Blocking Light from 10,000 Galaxies
hook: A massive structure of dark matter is acting like an invisible wall, bending and blocking the light of entire galaxy clusters.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'wall' concept triggers imagination of cosmic prisons or barriers—easy to visualize and share.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: The Universe Is a Simulation—And We're the Glitch
hook: What if the Great Filter isn't death—but deletion? A physicist argues we're a bug in a cosmic program about to be patched.
why_this_can_go_viral: Simulation theory is already viral—this adds a dark 'we're about to be deleted' twist.

title: The Comet That Carries a Virus That Only Affects the Human Brain
hook: A comet passing through the inner solar system contains prion-like compounds that can cross the blood-brain barrier.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pandemic fear + space = double anxiety trigger. 'Brain-targeting space virus' is pure clickbait gold.

title: The Galaxy That Is Entirely Dead—But Still Emits a Signal Every 93 Seconds
hook: A galaxy with no active stars is pulsing a consistent radio burst—as if something is still alive inside the corpse.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'ghost galaxy' narrative is instantly creepy—combines death, mystery, and a repeating heartbeat.

title: The Declassified Russian Cosmonaut Tape: 'We Hear Scratching from the Hull'
hook: A leaked transcript from Salyut 7 records cosmonauts hearing rhythmic scratching on the hull—while in deep space silence.
why_this_can_go_viral: Audio-based horror in space is instantly shareable—people will beg for the 'real' recording.

title: The Rogue Planet That Is a Perfect Sphere—Something That Shouldn't Exist
hook: Astronomers found a rogue planet with zero oblateness—perfectly spherical. That's impossible for a natural object.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'perfect sphere' triggers the 'ancient alien megastructure' crowd—easy visual hook.

title: The Mass Extinction That Happened in a Single Day—And Left Footprints
hook: Fossilized footprints show animals running from something—then suddenly stopping. The extinction was instant.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'frozen in time' horror of running animals suddenly dying is cinematic and deeply unsettling.

title: The Star That Is Draining Energy from Nearby Planets—Like a Vampire
hook: A white dwarf is siphoning material from a planet in its system—but the planet isn't being pulled in; it's staying in orbit while slowly dying.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'vampire star' metaphor is catchy and easy to visualize—cosmic horror with a human face.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: Every Civilization Builds a Dyson Sphere—Then Suffocates
hook: A model shows that Dyson spheres trap heat so efficiently they cook their creators. Silence means they all overheated.
why_this_can_go_viral: Turns a sci-fi dream into a nightmare—'the solution that kills you' is a powerful narrative.

title: The Secret Space Plane That Spent 780 Days Orbiting—Then Landed with a Cargo
hook: The X-37B space plane returned after 2 years in orbit—and unofficial sources say it brought something back from high orbit.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'secret space plane with mysterious cargo' is a perennial viral favorite—combines military secrecy with cosmic mystery.
